props.name: trigger
props.description: The closed state — a card, a tile, a row. Clicking it opens the dialog.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading. Becomes the accessible name.

props.name: width
props.description: Dialog width in pixels, capped to the viewport.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger, when the trigger is not self-describing.

props.name: dialogClassName
props.description: Classes for the opened panel rather than for the trigger.
